Great Sushi address!!!
Jun 2024 • Couples
Finally a sushi restaurant not far from the house: there are 2 addresses, one in district 1 in a small alley and another in district 2 not far from Thao Dien. I tried both and they are perfectly identical in quality, freshness and decoration. Everything is good, quickly on the table: the menu is found on your phone after scanning the QR code. Please note they only take cash or payment by telephone (QR code) no credit cards. If you are used to eating between 7.30/8.30 it is better to book, victim of its success and very low prices for this choice and quality.

Great sushi, good price
Feb 2020
If you’re craving sushi, this is the place to go. It may be a bit out of the way, but the food, the ambiance and the area are definitely worth it. The sushi was really good, freshly made, and just kept arriving as it was ready. We had mostly rolls and some nigiri, all fresh, all delicious. The place was packed (not tourists!) and we waited for a table, but it was definitely worth the wait, and a really good deal too!

Rubbery Rice
Jan 2019 • Friends
Hey, folks, really, Sushi Nhí is overrated. The octopus was outstanding and the various slices of fish were OK but the salmon eggs (ikura) and capelin eggs (tarako) bordered on tasteless. Worst, the sushi rice was an oddly flavored, decidely chewy mass. All the neighborly ambience and low prices can't make up for something that just wasn't real sushi. If you go to Sushi Nhí, stick to sashimi.
